about: Craft lessons of 2026-11-22..25, written by Claude from the Lab handoffs and commit messages. 'why' says what was measured; 'not measured here' = general practice, for Scott to judge.

notes.do: For a drawn or painted look, open your detail with the medium and style, then describe brushwork, line or paper. Never use camera words (lens, bokeh, depth of field, cinematic, photo).
notes.why: Live A/B on Lustify v8, 2026-11-24: style after his words 0/4 drawn; style first drew pixel art, storybook and watercolor. Watercolor and comic came out as photos until photo words were pushed away.

notes.do: Show mood through light, weather, colour and posture. Never write a mood or feeling as a single loose word or tag.
notes.why: Live 2026-11-24: the tag 'calm' was painted as a bus stop sign reading CALM.

notes.do: Describe nothing that carries writing unless he asked for words: no signs, posters, screens, labels, captions, logos or signatures.
notes.why: Live 2026-11-24: Chroma drew fake artist signatures in 2 of 3 paintings; a long prompt was drawn as a table of text.

notes.do: Name no artist, and do not use the words signed or unsigned.
notes.why: Live 2026-11-24: 'unsigned' plus the no-text negative still gave signatures on Chroma; Lustify v8 was clean 4 of 4.

notes.do: Add only what makes his scene clearer: setting, light, angle, texture. No clothing, covering, extra people or body details he did not ask for.
notes.why: Live 2026-11-24: the writer added 'a flowing dress' he never asked for.

notes.do: When he gives a number of things, say 'exactly N' and place them apart, each whole and in view (in a row or evenly spaced), so they can be counted. Add no extra ones in the background.
notes.why: Eyes live 2026-11-25: fox pictures scored 100% and 67%; the miss was the count. The wording itself is not measured here yet.

notes.do: Keep who the person is in every view: same face, hair, build, age and outfit. Change only the pose, angle and place he asked for.
notes.why: Character sheet live 2026-11-25: 2/5 views matched before the sheet kept her description, 4/4 after.

notes.do: Keep hands simple and in plain view: one clear action per hand, nothing tangled or half hidden.
notes.why: Anatomy Study 2026-11-25 moved to arms framing with no hand focus. Not measured here.

notes.do: Describe one continuous motion that fits the clip length, and at most one camera move. No cuts and no scene changes.
notes.why: General practice for short image-to-video clips. Not measured here.

notes.do: When a first picture exists, say only what moves and how. Do not describe the scene again or add new things to it.
notes.why: Picture-first is the default video path (2026-11-24). Not measured here.

notes.do: No captions, subtitles, titles or on-screen writing.
notes.why: Same no-writing rule as pictures; Eyes checks a middle frame for it.

notes.do: Each shot says only what a picture can show: who, where, pose, light, camera. No thoughts, sounds, dialogue or time passing inside one shot.
notes.why: Story build 2026-11-25: Eyes was changed to grade only what a picture can show, after shot words held things no still can.

notes.do: Name each character the same way in every shot and repeat their two fixed traits (hair, outfit) so stills stay the same person.
notes.why: Cast references and continuity flags, 2026-11-25. Not measured here.

notes.do: Count only the people the action needs. Ignore onlookers and crowds in the source clip.
notes.why: Rebuild R5 2026-11-25: the live clip had a crowd and the count check failed on bystanders.

notes.do: Shrink pictures to 1280 px JPEG before sending several to Hermes; its limit is 10 MB per call.
gandalf's card runs one heavy local job at a time. Never start a local video while local pictures are being made.
notes.why: 2026-11-25 07:43: a local Wan 2.2 video job hit card-memory failures and hermes-comfy stopped mid picture run.

notes.do: Quality tags and model negatives live once, in Hermes comfy/models.py. The Lab sends scene tags only.
notes.why: 2026-11-24: both sides added them, so Pony's score chain and Illustrious 'masterpiece' were sent twice.

notes.do: One failed Hermes call costs one item, never the whole batch. Catch it per item and go on.
notes.why: Live 2026-11-24: RemoteDisconnected on picture 2 ended a 4-picture batch after 1 was made.

notes.do: The 4b vision judge tops out near 95 and can miss small drift. Test any new check once on a planted mismatch before trusting it.
notes.why: Eyes M2 live 2026-11-25: it gave 95 four times in a row.
